name: difficult-conversations-kids
description:
Provides age-appropriate language frameworks and conversation guides for discussing difficult topics with children, including divorce, death, major life changes, illness, and family disruptions. Produces structured conversation plans with opening scripts, follow-up responses, and ongoing support strategies.
Use when the user needs help talking to a child about a difficult topic such as divorce, death, moving, serious illness, or other major life changes.
Do NOT use for grief therapy, clinical assessment of a child's emotional state, or replacing a child psychologist's guidance.
